verses.pali: “Cha, bhikkhave, dhamme appahāya abhabbo kāye kāyānupassī viharituṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, without giving up these six qualities you can’t meditate observing an aspect of the body.

verses.pali: Kammārāmataṁ, bhassārāmataṁ, niddārāmataṁ, saṅgaṇikārāmataṁ, indriyesu aguttadvārataṁ, bhojane amattaññutaṁ.
verses.english: Relishing work, talk, sleep, and company, not guarding the sense doors, and eating too much.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cha dhamme appahāya abhabbo kāye kāyānupassī viharituṁ.
verses.english: Without giving up these six qualities you can’t meditate observing an aspect of the body.

verses.pali: Cha, bhikkhave, dhamme pahāya bhabbo kāye kāyānupassī viharituṁ.
verses.english: But after giving up these six qualities you can meditate observing an aspect of the body.

verses.pali: Kammārāmataṁ, bhassārāmataṁ, niddārāmataṁ, saṅgaṇikārāmataṁ, indriyesu aguttadvārataṁ, bhojane amattaññutaṁ.
verses.english: Relishing work, talk, sleep, and company, not guarding the sense doors, and eating too much.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cha dhamme pahāya bhabbo kāye kāyānupassī viharitun”ti.
verses.english: After giving up these six qualities you can meditate observing an aspect of the body.”
